    16→
    17→use crate::args::EvalsTestArgs;
    18→
    19→use super::get_app_and_start_request;
    20→use crate::health::HealthMonitor;
    21→use serde_json::json;
    22→use spiceai::Client as SpiceClient;
    23→use std::time::{Duration, SystemTime};
    24→use test_framework::{
    25→    anyhow,
    26→    arrow::{
    27→        array::{Float64Array, RecordBatch, StringArray},
    28→        util::pretty::pretty_format_batches,
    29→    },
    30→    constants::{EVALS_ENDPOINT_PREFIX, HTTP_BASE_URL},
    31→    futures::TryStreamExt,
    32→    git,
    33→    opentelemetry::KeyValue,
    34→    opentelemetry_sdk::Resource,
    35→    spiced::SpicedInstance,
    36→    telemetry::Telemetry,
    37→};
    38→
    39→/// Status of an evaluation run
    40→#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq)]
    41→pub enum EvalStatus {
    42→    Finished,
    43→    Failed,
    44→}
    45→
    46→impl EvalStatus {
    47→    /// Convert a status string to `EvalStatus`
    48→    pub fn from_str(status: &str) -> Self {
    49→        match status.to_lowercase().as_str() {
    50→            "completed" => EvalStatus::Finished,
    51→            _ => EvalStatus::Failed,
    52→        }
    53→    }
    54→
    55→    /// Convert `EvalStatus` to a boolean value for metrics recording
    56→    pub fn to_u64(&self) -> u64 {
    57→        match self {
    58→            EvalStatus::Finished => 1,
    59→            EvalStatus::Failed => 0,
    60→        }
    61→    }
    62→}
    63→
    64→/// Metrics from an evaluation run
    65→#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
    66→pub struct EvalMetrics {
    67→    pub status: EvalStatus,
    68→    pub score: f64,
    69→}
    70→
    71→impl EvalMetrics {
    72→    pub fn from_record_batch(batch: &[RecordBatch]) -> anyhow::Result<Self> {
    73→        let record = batch
    74→            .iter()
    75→            .find(|b| b.num_rows() > 0)
    76→            .ok_or_else(|| anyhow::anyhow!("No evaluation metrics found"))?;
    77→
    78→        let status_str = record
    79→            .column_by_name("status")
    80→            .and_then(|col| col.as_any().downcast_ref::<StringArray>())
    81→            .ok_or_else(|| anyhow::anyhow!("Failed to extract status"))?
    82→            .value(0);
    83→        let status = EvalStatus::from_str(status_str);
    84→
    85→        let score = record
    86→            .column_by_name("score")
    87→            .and_then(|col| col.as_any().downcast_ref::<Float64Array>())
    88→            .ok_or_else(|| anyhow::anyhow!("Failed to extract score"))?
    89→            .value(0);
    90→
    91→        Ok(EvalMetrics { status, score })
    92→    }
    93→}
    94→
    95→pub(crate) async fn run(args: &EvalsTestArgs) -> anyhow::Result<()> {
    96→    let (app, start_request) = get_app_and_start_request(&args.common).await?;
    97→    let mut spiced_instance = SpicedInstance::start(start_request).await?;
    98→
    99→    let eval = args
   100→        .eval
   101→        .as_ref()
   102→        .or_else(|| app.evals.first().map(|eval| &eval.name))
   103→        .ok_or_else(|| anyhow::anyhow!("No evals defined"))?;
   104→
   105→    let model = args
   106→        .model
   107→        .as_ref()
   108→        .or_else(|| app.models.first().map(|model| &model.name))
   109→        .ok_or_else(|| anyhow::anyhow!("No models defined"))?;
   110→
   111→    spiced_instance
   112→        .wait_for_ready(Duration::from_secs(args.common.ready_wait))
   113→        .await?;
   114→
   115→    // Build resource with attributes known upfront, before creating telemetry.
   116→    // This ensures the SdkMeterProvider is created with the correct resource.
   117→    let benchmark_resource = Resource::builder_empty()
   118→        .with_attributes(vec![
   119→            KeyValue::new("service.name", "testoperator"),
   120→            KeyValue::new("type", "model_benchmark"),
   121→            KeyValue::new("spiced_version", spiced_instance.version().to_string()),
   122→            KeyValue::new("spiced_commit_sha", git::get_commit_sha()),
   123→            KeyValue::new("testoperator_commit_sha", git::get_commit_sha()),
   124→            KeyValue::new("branch_name", git::get_branch_name()),
   125→        ])
   126→        .build();
   127→
   128→    // Create telemetry with resource upfront, before any metrics calls
   129→    let telemetry =
   130→        Telemetry::new_with_resource(&benchmark_resource, "SPICEAI_BENCHMARK_METRICS_KEY");
   131→
   132→    let health_monitor = HealthMonitor::spawn()?;
   133→
   134→    println!("Executing {eval} eval benchmark for model {model}. It might take several minutes...");
   135→
   136→    let http_client = spiced_instance.http_client()?;
   137→
   138→    let url = format!("{HTTP_BASE_URL}{EVALS_ENDPOINT_PREFIX}/{eval}");
   139→    let body = json!({"model": model}).to_string();
   140→
   141→    let started_at = SystemTime::now().duration_since(std::time::UNIX_EPOCH)?;
   142→
   143→    let response = http_client
   144→        .post(&url)
   145→        .header("Content-Type", "application/json")
   146→        .body(body)
   147→        .send()
   148→        .await?;
   149→
   150→    let finished_at = SystemTime::now().duration_since(std::time::UNIX_EPOCH)?;
   151→
   152→    let response_status = response.status();
   153→    let response_msq = response.text().await?;
   154→
   155→    if !response_status.is_success() {
   156→        let health_report = health_monitor.stop().await;
   157→        spiced_instance.stop()?;
   158→        let health_report = health_report?;
   159→
   160→        let mut failure_messages = vec![format!("Failed to execute evals: {response_msq}")];
   161→        if let Some(message) = health_report.failure_message() {
   162→            failure_messages.push(message);
   163→        }
   164→
   165→        return Err(anyhow::anyhow!(failure_messages.join("\n")));
   166→    }
   167→
   168→    println!("Evals completed:\n{response_msq}");
   169→
   170→    println!("Retrieving results...");
   171→
   172→    let mut spice_client = spiced_instance.spice_client(None, false).await?;
   173→
   174→    let eval_result = execute_sql(&mut spice_client, QUERY_EVAL_BENCHMARK_MAIN_METRICS).await?;
   175→    println!("Result:\n{}\n", pretty_format_batches(&eval_result)?);
   176→
   177→    // Extract metrics from the evaluation result. If the evaluation run was not successful (EvalStatus::Failed),
   178→    // we will return an error at the end after printing statistics and cleaning up.
   179→    let metrics = EvalMetrics::from_record_batch(&eval_result)?;
   180→
   181→    let tasks_calls = execute_sql(&mut spice_client, QUERY_EVAL_BENCHMARK_TASKS).await?;
   182→    println!(
   183→        "Executed tasks:\n{}\n",
   184→        pretty_format_batches(&tasks_calls)?
   185→    );
   186→
   187→    let failed_tests = execute_sql(&mut spice_client, QUERY_EVAL_BENCHMARK_FAILED_TESTS).await?;
   188→    // json format is easier to read as table could be too wide
   189→    println!("Failed tests:\n{}\n", arrow_to_json(&failed_tests)?);
   190→
   191→    let top_errors = execute_sql(&mut spice_client, QUERY_EVAL_BENCHMARK_TOP_ERRORS).await?;
   192→    // json format is easier to read as table could be too wide
   193→    println!("Top errors:\n{}\n", arrow_to_json(&top_errors)?);
   194→
   195→    // Record benchmark results
   196→    let attributes = vec![
   197→        KeyValue::new("model_name", model.clone()),
   198→        KeyValue::new("benchmark_name", eval.clone()),
   199→    ];
   200→    crate::metrics::STATUS.record(metrics.status.to_u64(), &attributes);
   201→    crate::metrics::SCORE.record(metrics.score, &attributes);
   202→    crate::metrics::TEST_DURATION.record(
   203→        u64::try_from((finished_at - started_at).as_millis())?,
   204→        &attributes,
   205→    );
   206→
   207→    telemetry.emit().await?;
   208→
   209→    let health_report = health_monitor.stop().await;
   210→    spiced_instance.stop()?;
   211→    let health_report = health_report?;
   212→
   213→    // Report unsuccessful evaluation run as an error
   214→    let mut failure_messages = Vec::new();
   215→    if matches!(metrics.status, EvalStatus::Failed) {
   216→        failure_messages.push("Evaluation run failed".to_string());
   217→    }
   218→    if let Some(message) = health_report.failure_message() {
   219→        failure_messages.push(message);
   220→    }
   221→
   222→    if !failure_messages.is_empty() {
   223→        return Err(anyhow::anyhow!(failure_messages.join("\n")));
   224→    }
   225→
   226→    println!("Benchmark completed successfully!");
   227→
   228→    Ok(())
   229→}
   230→
   231→async fn execute_sql(
   232→    spice_client: &mut SpiceClient,
   233→    sql: &str,
   234→) -> Result<Vec<RecordBatch>, anyhow::Error> {
   235→    let res = spice_client
   236→        .sql(sql)
   237→        .await?
   238→        .try_collect::<Vec<RecordBatch>>()
   239→        .await?;
   240→    Ok(res)
   241→}
   242→
   243→/**
   244→ * Fetches key metrics for the latest evaluation run, including duration, evaluation score, task call counts, and errors.
   245→ *
   246→ * Output:
   247→ * - `run_id`: Evaluation run ID
   248→ * - `model`: Model name
   249→ * - `status`: Run status
   250→ * - `tests`: Number of tests performed
   251→ * - `duration_seconds`: Eval duration (seconds)
   252→ * - `score`: Rounded average score
   253→ * - `task_calls`: Total task invocations
   254→ * - `task_errors`: Task task errors
   255→ *
   256→ * Example:
   257→ * +----------------------------------+-------------+-----------+-------+------------------+--------+------------+-------------+
   258→ * | `run_id`                         | `model`     | `status`  |`tests`|`duration_seconds`|`score` |`task_calls`|`task_errors`|
   259→ * +----------------------------------+-------------+-----------+-------+------------------+--------+------------+-------------+
   260→ * | c74a65614ea314bc7036489bbc6f7ba3 | gpt-4o-mini | Completed | 11    | 83.0             | 0.8182 | 209        | 100         |
   261→ * +----------------------------------+-------------+-----------+-------+------------------+--------+------------+-------------+
   262→ */
   263→static QUERY_EVAL_BENCHMARK_MAIN_METRICS: &str = "
   264→WITH latest_run AS (
   265→    SELECT id, created_at, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (completed_at - created_at)) AS duration_seconds
   266→    FROM spice.eval.runs
   267→    ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1
   268→),
   269→score AS (
   270→    SELECT run_id, AVG(value) AS overall_score, COUNT(*) AS evals_count
   271→    FROM spice.eval.results
   272→    WHERE run_id = (SELECT id FROM latest_run)
   273→    GROUP BY run_id
   274→),
   275→tool_stats AS (
   276→    SELECT
   277→        COUNT(*) AS task_calls,
   278→        COUNT(CASE WHEN error_message IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) AS task_errors
   279→    FROM runtime.task_history
   280→    WHERE
   281→        task != 'test_connectivity'
   282→        AND start_time BETWEEN (SELECT created_at FROM latest_run)
   283→        AND COALESCE(end_time, NOW())
   284→)
   285→SELECT r.id AS run_id, r.model, r.status, s.evals_count AS tests, lr.duration_seconds, ROUND(s.overall_score, 4) as score, ts.task_calls, ts.task_errors
   286→FROM spice.eval.runs r
   287→JOIN latest_run lr ON r.id = lr.id
   288→LEFT JOIN score s ON r.id = s.run_id
   289→LEFT JOIN tool_stats ts ON 1 = 1;
   290→";
   291→
   292→/**
   293→ * Retrieves statistis on executed tasks/tools during the latest evaluation run.
   294→ *
   295→ * Output:
   296→ * - `task`: Task name
   297→ * - `calls`: Total number of task calls
   298→ * - `failures`: Total number of task failures
   299→ * - `duration_ms`: Aggregated task duration in milliseconds
   300→ *
   301→ * Example:
   302→ * +-------------------------+-------+----------+--------------------+
   303→ * | `task`                  |`calls`|`failures`| `duration_ms`      |
   304→ * +-------------------------+-------+----------+--------------------+
   305→ * |`ai_completion`          | 72    | 0        | 77136.66854858398  |
   306→ * |`sql_query`              | 64    | 50       | 140.39500185847282 |
   307→ * |`tool_use::sql`          | 62    | 50       | 135.9049990773201  |
   308→ * |`tool_use::list_datasets`| 11    | 0        | 0.9290000051259995 |
   309→ * +-------------------------+-------+----------+--------------------+
   310→ */
   311→static QUERY_EVAL_BENCHMARK_TASKS: &str = "
   312→WITH latest_run AS (
   313→  SELECT id
   314→  FROM spice.eval.runs
   315→  ORDER BY created_at DESC
   316→  LIMIT 1
   317→)
   318→SELECT
   319→  task,
   320→  COUNT(*) AS calls,
   321→  COUNT(CASE WHEN error_message IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) AS failures,
   322→  SUM(CAST((end_time - start_time) AS Float) /  1000000) AS duration_ms
   323→FROM runtime.task_history
   324→WHERE
   325→  task != 'test_connectivity'
   326→  AND start_time BETWEEN (SELECT created_at FROM spice.eval.runs WHERE id = (SELECT id FROM latest_run)) AND
   327→  COALESCE(end_time, NOW())
   328→GROUP BY task
   329→ORDER BY duration_ms DESC;
   330→";
   331→
   332→/**
   333→ * Fetches the top task errors for the latest evaluation run aggregated by associated task name, error message, and input
   334→ *
   335→ * Output:
   336→ * - `task`: Task name
   337→ * - `count`: Number of error occurrences
   338→ * - `message`: Error message
   339→ * - `input`: Input causing the error
   340→ *
   341→ * Example:
   342→ * +---------------+-------+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
   343→ * | `task`        |`count`| `message`                                                                             | `input`                                                                           |
   344→ * +---------------+-------+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
   345→ * |`tool_use::sql`| 17    | Failed to execute query: SQL error: ParserError("Expected: an expression:, found: '") | {"query":"SELECT `nation` FROM `spice`.`public`.`customer` WHERE `c_custkey` = 1"}|
   346→ * +---------------+-------+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
   347→ */
